headline: Johnvents Industries Oversubscribes N80 Billion Commercial Paper
summary: Johnvents Industries Limited's N80 billion Series 1 Commercial Paper issuance was oversubscribed, reflecting strong investor confidence in the company.
why: Commercial paper issuances are short-term debt instruments used by corporations to fund working capital, and oversubscription indicates strong institutional liquidity and credit appetite.

impacts.name: Johnvents Industries Limited
impacts.why: Successful debt issuance provides capital for operations and validates investor confidence.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
